top_findings.title: Standings split one club into two rows (Athletico/Atletico Paranaense) — 21 rows for a 20-team season
top_findings.evidence: Normalizer.key() (Normalizer.java:10-14) strips accents (NFD + combining-mark removal) and the -XX state suffix but NOT the 'h' variant, so key('Athletico Paranaense')='athletico paranaense' != key('Atletico Paranaense')='atletico paranaense'. SoccerService.update() (SoccerService.java:32) keys the standings HashMap by Normalizer.key(team), so the two spellings become two rows. Data has both: 218 'Athletico Paranaense' vs 222 'Atletico Paranaense' + 33 'Atlético Paranaense' in data/kaggle/*.csv. _factual.json standings output: 'Athletico Paranaense' (27 matches, 48 pts) and 'Atletico Paranaense' (11 matches, 16 pts) appear separately (27+11=38 = one club's season); count=21 for a 20-team Série A; factual gate flagged '3 Atlético/Athletico rows, expected 2'.
top_findings.suggestion: Reconcile the 'h' variant in Normalizer.key() (e.g. collapse 'athletico'->'atletico', or map known club aliases) so a single club aggregates into one standings row.
